as_told.title: UFO link to the JFK assassination

plain: Two researchers claim that the killing of President Kennedy in 1963 is tied to the UFO story that runs back to 1947. The writer Peter Levenda tells Michels, "I think I've shown through documentation the connection with the UFO phenomenon and the Kennedy assassination." He points to his book Sinister Forces, and the people he draws in include J. Edgar Hoover. A second teller, the UFO historian Richard Dolan, says on another episode that the UFO subject "absolutely must be brought into" the Kennedy case. Dolan credits two other people, Philip Lavell and Dan Sheehan, for that view, not Levenda's documents. Neither man spells out the link in the passages given. They raise it because, if true, a president's murder would be bound up with UFO secrecy.
